prompt: Use an ExecutorService with a fixed pool of 4 threads to square a list of numbers via Callables and Futures, preserving input order. Complete the squares method.
explanation: An ExecutorService decouples submitting work from running it: submit() hands a Callable to the pool and immediately returns a Future ticket. The tasks may finish in any order on the 4 worker threads, but because the Futures are stored in submission order and get() blocks until each one is done, reading them in order rebuilds the results in input order. shutdown() (here in a finally block) tells the pool to stop accepting work so its threads can exit.
hints: Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4) gives you an ExecutorService; pool.submit(() -> n * n) returns a Future<Integer>.
First loop: submit every task and add each Future to a List<Future<Integer>>. Do not call get() inside this first loop.
Second loop: call get() on each Future in list order and add the values to the result list; call pool.shutdown() before returning (a finally block is a good place).
